summary: Implemented the endpoint-resolver builtins feature. Changes: botocore/regions.py adds `from enum import Enum` and the `EndpointResolverBuiltins(str, Enum)` class with the 11 members from the spec. botocore/args.py imports it as `EPRBuiltins`, makes `_should_set_global_sts_endpoint` accept a None endpoint config (no variant tags), and adds `compute_endpoint_resolver_builtin_defaults` after `_ensure_boolean`. tests/unit/test_args.py adds `TestEndpointResolverBuiltins` (23 tests) covering every behavioral criterion. Results: tests/unit/test_args.py passes (59 tests). The full unit suite shows 11 failures in test_awsrequest.py, test_session.py and test_session_legacy.py, which also fail on a clean HEAD export, so they predate this change. Not verified: black, isort and flake8 are not installed in the shared venv, so lint was checked by hand only (no added line over 79 columns). Choices: absent SDK endpoint is returned as None under the SDK_ENDPOINT key; FIPS/DualStack use `or False`; the helper calls the bridge's private `_resolve_endpoint_variant_config_var` and `_resolve_use_dualstack_endpoint`. Nothing is committed.
